title: Fire Alarm / Sprinkler Isolation Permit
name: Fire Alarm / Sprinkler Isolation Permit
description: Controls temporary isolation of fire detection, alarm or sprinkler systems, including compensatory measures, responsible persons and reinstatement.

sections.title: ISOLATION AUTHORISATION
items: The exact devices, zones or valves to be isolated are identified
Isolation is limited to the minimum area and duration necessary
The effect on alarm, detection, suppression and evacuation arrangements has been assessed
Relevant building/site management has authorised the isolation
Emergency contact and escalation arrangements are available

fields.label: Devices / Zones / Valves to be Isolated

sections.title: COMPENSATORY FIRE PRECAUTIONS
items: Temporary fire watch or additional patrols are provided where required
Manual call / communication arrangements remain available
Escape routes and fire-fighting equipment remain available
Hot works or other ignition risks are reviewed while systems are impaired
Affected occupants / contractors are informed where necessary

sections.title: REINSTATEMENT AND TEST
items: Work is complete and the affected area is safe
All isolated devices / zones / valves are reinstated
Any impairment tags / notices are removed
System function is tested in accordance with site procedure
Relevant parties are informed that protection is restored
